users_totp_enabled_needs_secret.name: users_totp_enabled_needs_secret
users_totp_enabled_needs_secret.value: "users"."totp_enabled_at" IS NULL OR "users"."totp_secret_enc" IS NOT NULL

events_cancellation_consistent.name: events_cancellation_consistent
events_cancellation_consistent.value:
("events"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) = ("events"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL)
       AND ("events"."status" <> 'cancelled' OR "events"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

guests_name_len.name: guests_name_len
guests_name_len.value: "guests"."anonymized_at" IS NOT NULL OR char_length("guests"."full_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 150

guests_phone_required.name: guests_phone_required
guests_phone_required.value: "guests"."source" = 'walk_in' OR "guests"."phone_e164" IS NOT NULL OR "guests"."anonymized_at" IS NOT NULL

guests_cancellation_consistent.name: guests_cancellation_consistent
guests_cancellation_consistent.value:
("guests"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("guests"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)
       AND ("guests"."cancel_reason" IS NULL OR "guests"."status" = 'cancelled')

guests_cancel_reason_len.name: guests_cancel_reason_len
guests_cancel_reason_len.value: "guests"."cancel_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("guests"."cancel_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

guest_passes_revoked_consistent.name: guest_passes_revoked_consistent
guest_passes_revoked_consistent.value:
("guest_passes"."status" = 'revoked') = ("guest_passes"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
       AND ("guest_passes"."revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("guest_passes"."revoke_reason" IS NULL)

invitation_designs_title_len.name: invitation_designs_title_len
invitation_designs_title_len.value: "invitation_designs"."title" IS NULL OR char_length("invitation_designs"."title") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

invitations_share_consistent.name: invitations_share_consistent
invitations_share_consistent.value:
("invitations"."share_count" = 0) = ("invitations"."first_shared_at" IS NULL)
       AND ("invitations"."first_shared_at" IS NULL) = ("invitations"."last_shared_at" IS NULL)

invitations_open_consistent.name: invitations_open_consistent
invitations_open_consistent.value:
("invitations"."open_count" = 0) = ("invitations"."opened_at" IS NULL)
       AND ("invitations"."opened_at" IS NULL) = ("invitations"."last_opened_at" IS NULL)

message_templates_body.name: message_templates_body
message_templates_body.value: char_length("message_templates"."body") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND position('{link}' in "message_templates"."body") > 0

rsvps_actor_consistent.name: rsvps_actor_consistent
rsvps_actor_consistent.value:
("rsvps"."status" = 'pending') = ("rsvps"."last_actor_type" IS NULL)
       AND ("rsvps"."last_actor_membership_id" IS NULL OR "rsvps"."last_actor_type" = 'member')

check_in_logs_reason_len.name: check_in_logs_reason_len
check_in_logs_reason_len.value: "check_in_logs"."reason" IS NULL OR char_length("check_in_logs"."reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

staff_access_links_used_once.name: staff_access_links_used_once
staff_access_links_used_once.value: "staff_access_links"."redeemed_at" IS NULL OR "staff_access_links"."revoked_at" IS NULL OR "staff_access_links"."revoked_at" >= "staff_access_links"."redeemed_at"
